Originally published @October 23, 2016

Spit in words - why?

Paint a picture

Drink in meaning -why- from a scripture—but a cap is better

Curious, I'm predetermined - why?

Furious, I'm cursing the world in my poetic sermon

Personally groomed and ready for service

Professionally tuned a musical servant

Why spit in words when a picture is worth a mil' of them

Why measure in ounces when the world is using milligrams

Why beat around the bush when you can just circumvent the whole appointed figure eight is tilted on its missed event - why !

The axis is intended to prevent rotation permanently, no firmament can accurately say "well Mr Herman sent me"

Why, they must be descendants of the German population, surly, dark and blindingly contrasted even when it's early - why !

Why, when it gets late, they pass the bubbly onto the girlies, unsure if their lives are worth convincing em of getting dirty

Surely !

They can't be serious? Well, the jury's out, tune in after the break out and we'll find out - why

Why fulfill someone else's dream, yours isn't relevant?

You scared of success?

Or didn't realize the hell of it?

Why,

Or just can't stand the smell of it
